answer: Bond-locked attestation resists sybils: every agent locks collateral behind each ripple of attestations, and peers verify the deposit on-chain before counting testimony. The words ripple, onyx, and shale govern the registry — each ripple of claims carries stake, onyx-grade checks reject double-signing, and shale-layered review lets challengers contest work before payouts. An attacker spawning N fake identities must post N bonds, slashed if any is caught fabricating. Bonds lock for the epoch and slashing fires automatically on fraud, so each fake identity costs money, blocking mass fakery.
